**6\-month contract with possible extension for a SMB/EMM Planning \& Data Analyst in Atlanta, GA** 




**Job Overview** 




 SMB and Emerging Mid\-Market (EMM) are core growth engines for our product, spanning Care Dedicated Sales, Allbound Inbound/Outbound, EMM, and Supplies — with Online Advanced as a flagship growth line inside that portfolio. As the business scales, we're turning a reactive, run\-the\-business reporting function into a forward\-looking planning engine, and this role is the analytical backbone behind that effort — building and maintaining funnel\-driver models, reconciling data across systems, and doing the hands\-on SQL and modeling work that turns raw booking and pipeline data into a plan leadership can trust.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**Funnel \& Driver Modeling** 



* Build and maintain bottoms\-up, driver\-based funnel models (Inputs, SQL, SQO, Wins) covering New and Expansion motion across SMB/EMM channels
* Support the build\-out of a lever\-driven planning model where volume, conversion rate, and ARPC assumptions can be flexed and scenario\-tested (e.g., input volume scenarios, initiative upside cases)
* Maintain conversion rate and unit economics tracking (Start\-SQL, SQL\-Win, Start\-Win CVR; Units; ARPC/AOV; ARR) at the channel and segment level



  





**Data Analysis \& Reporting** 



* Write and maintain SQL against the sales data warehouse (Pydatalake/Databricks) to pull, validate, and reconcile booking, pipeline, and forecast data from source tables
* Own or co\-own recurring reporting (weekly review packs, data packs, dashboards) that leadership and Finance use to track plan vs. actual
* Investigate variance between plan and actuals, identify root cause, and package findings into clear, actionable summaries — not just raw numbers
* Reconcile figures across planning artifacts (allocation sheets, channel targets, funnel models) into one tied\-out number



  





**Rhythm of Business Support** 



* Support the weekly/monthly/quarterly planning and business review cadence — prepping data, building materials, and tracking follow\-through on decisions and action items.
* Help maintain planning data integrity in Anaplan and other planning systems, including hierarchy and assumption updates across planning passes.
* Flag data quality issues, broken pipelines, or reporting gaps proactively, before they surface in a leadership review.



  





**Qualifications** 




**Required** 



* 5\+ years in sales/business/revenue operations, FP\&A, business analytics, or a related analytical role, ideally at a SaaS or technology company.
* AI\-native — fluent working with Claude (e.g., Claude Code, Cowork, or similar) as a daily tool for data analysis, modeling, and workflow automation, not just occasional chat use.
* Strong SQL skills — comfortable writing and troubleshooting queries against a data warehouse (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, or similar) independently.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills; able to build and audit a driver\-based model, not just fill one in
* Experience with a BI tool (Tableau, Power BI, or similar) for dashboarding and reporting.
* Strong attention to detail and data integrity — comfortable being the person whose numbers get trusted without a re\-check
* Clear, structured communication — able to turn a data pull or model output into a summary a business stakeholder can act on
* Sound business judgment — able to translate a sales or planning question into the right analysis, sanity\-check outputs against business reality, and stay effective amid evolving priorities and imperfect data



  





**Preferred** 



* Familiarity with Anaplan or another enterprise planning platform.
* Exposure to sales funnel and B2B SaaS metrics (pipeline, conversion rates, ARR, unit economics).
* Experience supporting a recurring business review cadence (WBR/MBR/QBR) — prepping data and materials against a deadline.
